newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Union says ANZ plans to axe 3,000 jobs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Union says ANZ plans to axe 3,000 jobs.

text.p: Australia's Finance Sector Union said on Wednesday the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) planned to cut 3,000 jobs before Christmas -- a claim denied by the bank.
"There's no such number of jobs slated to disappear by the end of this year," ANZ spokesman David Wilson said.
He confirmed the bank's restructuring efforts would shed more jobs than the 1,250 staff cuts announced in April last year, but said it was too early to put a final number on the positions to be axed.
Earlier, the union's Victoria state secretary, John Wilson, quoted bank sources as the basis for his claim of 3,000 more job losses within the group.
"What we can go by is the information we have received both in our briefings from the bank and also from the information we are receiving from our contacts in the bank," he said.
"The processes that ANZ are currently going through show that they do not value their staff, they do not respect their staff and they do not trust their staff," he added.
